TwinzLab was founded by twin brothers Ahmed Zaki and Elmodather Zaki, who build and scale their own digital products.
TwinzLab is an independent product company. The name joins Twin, Gen Z, and Lab: two founders building their own products.
To build and scale digital products we own. Products that are simple, useful, and made for real use.
To grow a portfolio of digital products people use, and keep shipping the ones that earn their place.
Two minds that think differently, yet move in perfect sync.
Every pixel, component, and decision has a reason.
We craft products that feel smooth, robust, and timeless.
We experiment, explore, and push boundaries.
